mapper.select: SELECT year || LPAD(month, 2, '0') AS year, ROUND((SUM(ele/1000)/COUNT(*))) AS ele, ROUND((SUM(gas/1000)/COUNT(*))) AS gas, ROUND(SUM(ele_dsa)/COUNT(*)) AS ele_dsa, ROUND(SUM(gas_dsa)/COUNT(*)) AS gas_dsa FROM energy_data WHERE year = #{year} AND month BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} AND addr_cd LIKE #{code} || '%' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

SELECT year || LPAD(month, 2, '0') AS year, ROUND(AVG(ele/1000)) AS ele, ROUND(AVG(gas/1000)) AS gas, ROUND(AVG(ele_dsa)) AS ele_dsa, ROUND(AVG(gas_dsa)) AS gas_dsa FROM energy_data WHERE year = #{year} AND month BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

SELECT year || LPAD(month, 2, '0') AS year, -- 년월을 하나의 컬럼으로 생성 ROUND((SUM(pre_ele_usa/1000)/COUNT(*))) AS ele, ROUND((SUM(pre_gas_usa/1000)/COUNT(*))) AS gas, ROUND(SUM(pre_ele_emi)/COUNT(*)) AS ele_dsa, ROUND(SUM(pre_gas_emi)/COUNT(*)) AS gas_dsa FROM prediction_energy WHERE year = '2023' AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND addr_cd LIKE #{code} || '%' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

SELECT year || LPAD(month,2,0) year, ROUND(pre_ele_usa/1000) ele, ROUND(pre_gas_usa/1000) gas, ROUND(pre_ele_emi) ele_dsa, ROUND(pre_gas_emi) gas_dsa FROM prediction_energy WHERE year = '2023' AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND addr_cd LIKE #{code} || '%'
